newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers firm, buyers return in droves.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers firm, buyers return in droves.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices firmed by $1 a tonne on Thursday and many buyers returned to the market, as did many on Tuesday, dealers said.
Prices in most other markets were steady.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil was quoted in the range $87/$88 fob with the barge market at the top of this week's $85/$86 a tonne range.
Total ARA demand topped 20,000 tonnes by most estimates. Some said it was over 30,000 tonnes.
"It's picking up hour by hour and there are some quite big volumes," one supplier said.
Hamburg prices came off by $1 to $90/$91 fob. Dealers said supply appeared healthy for the coming week despite a rise of enquiries.
Mediterranean prices were unchanged and business in most ports was fairly quiet.
